review_method: Live web reading of the issuer article and its observed Legal link, followed by the Terms of use link. This is original review metadata, not an exact-byte source packet.

observed_links.clock_resolution: Both printed dates are preserved. Their timezone relationship was not established.
observed_links.scope_review: The principal project is a new NAND wafer fab. A separate paragraph discusses the previously announced Singapore HBM packaging project and a future 2027 supply contribution. The NAND investment, cleanroom area, wafer-output schedule and jobs must not be allocated to HBM packaging. Neither an achieved HBM production milestone nor an installed production rate is established.

observed_links.review_summary: The terms cover Micron websites and content, including downloads. The stated license is limited to temporary personal, non-commercial viewing, with restrictions on further copying and public display. The search-engine exception is purpose-specific and does not establish permission for this facility intelligence archive. No separate permission for durable project retention was found in this review.
observed_links.decision_basis: The required persistent raw-response archive is outside the limited permission established by this review. Do not activate this source without a separately reviewed applicable permission or license. Robots access alone would not resolve retention rights.

limitations: The review completion clock is not a document retrieval clock or source publication date.
Web-readable content does not prove direct collector access or exact-byte replay.
This decision is not a general legal determination or a statement that no other lawful source is available.
Micron remains in the full seven-facility denominator as unmonitored. No baseline fact or source record is revised.
The cross-origin policy link is recorded, not used to relax the existing same-origin collector contract.
next_action: Seek a separately rights-reviewed official distribution route or explicit retention permission. Do not bypass denied endpoints or enable a mirrored source solely to evade these restrictions.
